title: Module not found: Can't resolve './_next/static/media/b1db3e28af9ef94a-s.woff2'  After set   assetPrefix to '.',

body:

### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

### To Reproduce

modify next.config.js as following

```js
/** @type {import('next').NextConfig} */
const nextConfig = {
  reactStrictMode: true,
  assetPrefix: '.',    // or './'
}

module.exports = nextConfig
```
